Part 1 高频 物品 OBJECTS

Social media

社交媒体

⚠️ AI 范例，仅供学习 — IELTS 口语全程独立完成，背诵照搬 AI 答案会被考官识别为背稿。

问题与答案

Q1Have you ever posted anything on social media?

Yeah, of course, loads of times. I post photos and short updates about my daily life, like places I've been or meals I've had. It's a nice way to keep in touch with friends who don't live nearby.

发过很多次，发照片和日常动态，比如去过的地方、吃过的饭。

Q2When did you start using social media?

Quite early, actually, back in primary school. I think it was around then that I made my first account, probably to chat with classmates about homework and games. Social media has just been part of my life since then.

小学就开始用了，第一个账号用来和同学聊作业和游戏。

Q3Do you think you spend too much time on social media?

Not really, I don't think so. I use it mainly to check messages and catch up on news, but I don't scroll for hours. I'd say maybe an hour a day at most, and I'm fine with that.

不算多，主要看消息和新闻，每天最多一小时，不会刷太久。

Q4Do your friends use social media?

Oh, definitely, all of them do. I don't think I know anyone my age who isn't on at least one platform. It's basically how we share news and make plans these days, so we'd be lost without it.

朋友全都在用，同龄人几乎没有人不用社交平台。

Q5What do people often do on social media?

All sorts of things, really. Most people share their daily life, post photos, and follow news accounts for updates. Shopping has also become huge on social media lately, with built-in stores and live-stream selling.

分享日常、发照片、看新闻，现在购物和直播带货也很火。
